Precision and canonical representation of non-backup recorded instants
dispositions.what: The stored and wire representation of non-backup instants: UTC with time zone (L16), exact to the microsecond the tests compare; State 6's model closure fixes it.
options: UTC datetime with exact microsecond precision
UTC datetime with finer precision normalized on persistence
Backend-native precision preserving the required comparisons
consequences: The chosen contract representation must preserve ordering and equality required by the microsecond boundary tests.

dispositions.topic_text: Required security property of the A18 key digest
dispositions.what: The key digest's construction: State 6 fixes a domain-separated SHA-256 digest of the backup key (BACKUP_KEY_DIGEST_DOMAIN); A18 only requires the record to carry a digest that tells a wrong key without revealing it.
options: One-way password-hard derivation with a salt
consequences: The deciding State 6 text selects domain-separated SHA-256, a fast cryptographic hash.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether backup encryption must authenticate ciphertext and resist modification
dispositions.what: The backup cipher: State 6 fixes authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM with the readable record as associated data), a file failing authentication refused.
consequences: The deciding contract selects authenticated encryption with associated data.
